assumptions.source_types: Based on column classes in the supplied output. CSV dates use ISO text; the conversion script restores R Date values.
assumptions.file_relationship: Shared synthetic patient identifiers only. The four examples are generated independently; monthly N does not aggregate these daily fake files.
assumptions.mapping: No clinical local-to-group or code-to-CUI mapping has been inferred.
assumptions.code_validity: Generated identifiers preserve observed code formats; clinical validity and meaning are not asserted.

search_rules: Return file locations, source object names, row meaning and dictionary status.
Do not add N to daily files; each row counts as one occurrence.
Preserve patientnum vs PatientNum and cui vs Group_Code names.
NLP includes custom acronym concepts; do not require every cui to start with C.
Dictionary paths are not documented; do not reuse IBD dictionary paths for AD.
Do not equate source rows with patients.
Do not infer cohort coverage or distributions from fake data or the first 50 source rows.
